title: Trailer Body 3DOF
text: Trailer body with longitudinal, lateral, and yaw motion, 22 inputs, 9 outputs, {Vehicle track} sets Type of vehicle track Dual; {Axle forces} sets the type of axle force, {Front wheel steering} sets the whlAngF input port, {Middle wheel steering} sets the whlAngM input port, {Rear wheel steering} sets the whlAngR input port, {External wind} sets the windXYZ input port, {External friction} sets the mu input port, {External forces} sets the fExt input port, {External moments} sets the mExt input port, {Front hitch forces} sets the fhF input port, {Front hitch moments} sets the mhF input port, {Rear hitch forces} sets the fhR input port, {Rear hitch moments} sets the mhR input port, {Initial longitudinal position} sets the x_o input port, {Initial yaw angle} sets the psi_o input port, {Initial longitudinal velocity} sets the xdot_o input port, {Initial yaw rate} sets the r_o input port, {Initial lateral position} sets the y_o input port, {Air temperature} sets the airTemp input port, {Initial lateral velocity} sets the ydot_o input port, {Number of wheels on front axle, NF} sets the front wheel count, {Number of wheels on middle axle, NM} sets the middle wheel count, {Number of wheels on rear axle, NR} sets the rear wheel count, {Vehicle mass, m}, {Longitudinal distance from center of mass to front axle, a} sets the distance from CM to front axle, {Longitudinal distance from center of mass to middle axle, b} sets the distance from CM to middle axle, {Longitudinal distance from center of mass to rear axle, c} sets the distance from CM to rear axle, {Vertical distance from center of mass to axle plane, h} sets the distance from CM to axle plane, {Longitudinal distance from center of mass to front hitch, dh_f} sets the distance to front hitch, {Vertical distance from front hitch to axle plane, hh_f} sets the distance from front hitch to axle plane, {Longitudinal distance from center of mass to rear hitch, dh_r} sets the distance to front hitch, {Vertical distance from front hitch to axle plane, hh_r} sets the distance from rear hitch to axle plane, {Initial inertial frame longitudinal position, X_o} sets the initial inertial X location, {Initial longitudinal velocity, xdot_o} sets the initial velocity, {Mapped corner stiffness} sets the selection, {Include relaxation length dynamics} enables relaxation length dynamics, {Lateral distance from geometric centerline to center of mass, d} sets the distance from centerline to CM, {Lateral distance from geometric centerline to front hitch, hl_f} sets the distance from centerline to front hitch, {Lateral distance from geometric centerline to rear hitch, hl_r} sets the distance from centerline to rear hitch, {Front track width, w_f}, {Middle track width, w_m}, {Rear track width, w_r}, {Front axle tire corner stiffness, Cy_f} sets the front axle tire stiffness, {Middle axle tire corner stiffness, Cy_m} sets the middle axle tire stiffness, {Rear axle tire corner stiffness, Cy_r} sets the rear axle tire stiffness, {Front tire(s) relaxation length, sigma_f} sets the relaxation length .1, {Middle tire(s) relaxation length, sigma_m} sets the relaxation length .1, {Rear tire(s) relaxation length, sigma_r} sets the relaxation length .1, {Front axle slip angle breakpoints, alpha_f_brk} sets the breakpoints, {Front axle corner data, Cy_f_data} sets the breakpoints, {Middle axle slip angle breakpoints, alpha_m_brk} sets the breakpoints, {Middle axle corner data, Cy_m_data} sets the breakpoints, {Rear axle slip angle breakpoints, alpha_r_brk} sets the breakpoints, {Rear axle corner data, Cy_r_data} sets the data, {Initial inertial frame lateral displacement, Y_o} sets the position, {Initial lateral velocity, ydot_o} sets the velocity, {Yaw polar inertia, Izz} sets the inertia, {Initial yaw angle, psi_o} sets the psi rotation, {Initial yaw rate, r_o} sets the yaw rate, {Longitudinal drag area, Af} sets the effective vehicle cross-sectional area, {Longitudinal drag coefficient, Cd} sets the air drag coefficient .3, {Longitudinal lift coefficient, Cl} sets the air lift coefficient .1, {Longitudinal drag pitch moment, Cpm} sets the pitch drag .1, {Relative wind angle vector, beta_w} sets the wind angle, {Side force coefficient vector, Cs} sets the side force coefficient, {Yaw moment coefficient vector, Cym} sets the yaw moment drag, {Absolute air pressure, Pabs} sets the pressure, {Air temperature, Tair} sets the temperature, {Gravitational acceleration, g} sets the gravity, {Nominal friction scaling factor, mu} sets the friction scale factor, {Longitudinal velocity tolerance, xdot_tol} sets the tolerance .01, {Nominal normal force, Fznom} sets the normal force, {Geometric longitudinal offset from axle plane, longOff} sets the longitudinal offset, {Geometric lateral offset from center plane, latOff} sets the lateral offset, {Geometric vertical offset from axle plane, vertOff} sets the vertical offset and {Wrap Euler angles, wrapAng} sets the wrap the Euler angles to the interval. Values come from the instance.
